item.title: Hugo SEO on a Multi-Section Blog
item.description: Search and social previews on a Hugo blog are mostly template work: consistent titles, a real summary, a thumbnail, Open Graph / Twitter tags, structured data, and a sitemap. DevOpsTales does that in layouts/_default/baseof.html plus a JSON-LD partial—no SEO plugin required.
